en.headline: Hang Seng down 2.6% by late morning after holiday break
en.dek: The benchmark stood at 23,975.90 at 11:05am, down 637 points from Wednesday's close, after opening 513 points lower.
body: Hong Kong stocks opened sharply lower on Friday, the first session after the National Day holiday, with banks and technology shares leading the decline.

Hang Seng Indexes Company data showed the Hang Seng Index at 23,975.90 at 11:05am, down 637.37 points, or 2.59 percent, from Wednesday's close of 24,613.27. The index opened at 24,099.73, 513.54 points lower, and traded as low as 23,865.33. The session was still under way.

Market reports in the first hour said HSBC and Standard Chartered each fell about 5 percent at the open, while AIA was down more than 4 percent. By around 9:55am, reports had HSBC down about 4.8 percent and AIA down about 5 percent, with Alibaba, Meituan and Xiaomi also lower. Xinhua reported the opening drop of 2.09 percent.

zh.headline: 國慶假期後復市 恒指上午跌逾六百點
zh.dek: 恒指上午11時05分報23975點，較周三收市跌637點；今早低開513點，盤中曾低見23865點。
body: 港股周五在國慶假期後復市，早段明顯受壓，金融股及科技股領跌。
恒生指數公司資料顯示，恒生指數上午11時05分報23975.90點，較周三收市24613.27點下跌637.37點，跌幅2.59%。指數今早以24099.73點開出，低開513.54點，盤中低見23865.33點。上午交易仍在進行。
市場報道指，開市初段滙豐控股及渣打集團各跌約5%，友邦保險跌逾4%。約上午9時55分的報道則指，滙豐跌約4.8%，友邦跌約5%，阿里巴巴、美團及小米亦向下。新華社報道，恒指開市下跌2.09%。
